messages:
Maya: Quick, tiny poll — Snack Olympics for tomorrow's huddle. Which category should we stock? Reply with your pick or drop an emoji: chips, fruit, cookies, pretzels. :medal:
Sam: chips :chip: (gimme)
Jordan: fruit please, something easy to nosh between meetings :apple:
Lee: pretzels for sure
Sam: also +1 for extra napkins :tissue_box:
Jordan: @Lee no allergies, right?
Lee: all clear here
pollbot: Poll opened: options = [chips, fruit, cookies, pretzels]. React or reply with your vote. (automated)
Maya: I'll tally at 11:00 and place the order. thanks! :tada:
Sam: chips x2 (just being honest)
Jordan: fruit x1
Lee: pretzels x1
pollbot: Poll closed. Results: chips 2, fruit 1, pretzels 1, cookies 0
Maya: Chips win — ordering now. Anyone want me to add a small cookie pack on the side? :thinking:
Sam: if there's budget, +cookies :yum:
Jordan: nah, chips are fine
Maya: cool, chips it is. tally + order placed. see you at huddle! :sparkles:
